'''House Viholn''' was one of seventeen [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses that settled in the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] implemented the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. House Viholn became based in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], where it controlled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Knores]].
